PRESIDENT
Leadership
President's Message
Ln. Neelima Bushpala
President · LC Hyderabad Wings · 2025–2026
Service is not what we do — it is who we are. This year, Lions Club of Hyderabad Wings has proven that when we stand together, no challenge is too great and no community too distant.

From Hunger Relief drives to Eye Vision Camps, CPR Training at Gandhi Medical College, to sponsoring children's education — every action made a real difference in Hyderabad.

We welcomed 13 new Lions, conducted 47+ activities, served 1,500+ beneficiaries, supported women's dignity, celebrated our nation's pride, and stood with our District Governor.

Lead With Passion 2.0 · We Serve 🦁

WELLNESS
Division I · Service
🧠 Mental Health & Well-Being Week
Lions International Global Mental Health Initiative · October 4–12, 2025.
🧠
Mental Health & Well-Being Week
October 4–12, 2025 · 9 Activities
9 activities conducted across Hyderabad over 9 days as part of Lions International Global Mental Health Awareness Initiative:
• Mental health awareness rally with students
• School sessions: stress management, mindfulness, emotional well-being
• Meditation session at an orphanage
• International online mental health sessions
• Community service at Landmark Group — 50 beneficiaries served
~1,188 BeneficiariesOct 4–12, 20259 Sessions ConductedLandmark Group · 50 Served
